decisions.target_current_rule: After part of speech and motivating word are established, N/NN in the derived form follows the relevant spelling of the motivating base; do not transfer by visual similarity alone.
decisions.consolidation_policy: Keep school-nn-derived-noun-adverb-inheritance as the surviving identity, merge Grade-7 provenance/examples into it, and remove/deprecate school-adverb-n-nn-source-word-inheritance from the counted physical bank. Do not remove historical source records.

decisions.current_norm_note: All spellings remain current. The group is intentionally heterogeneous; in particular, приданое is a genuine memorized one-Н spelling and must not be mechanically derived from придать/приданный.
decisions.patch_policy: Keep as a source-backed dictionary-practice group; explain transparent members separately and do not invent one shared derivational exception rule.

current_model: In an ordinary personal clause, gerund and predicate actions share the agent.
A gerund construction is normative in an impersonal/generalized sentence containing an infinitive when the gerund and infinitive imply the same agent.
A dangling gerund in an impersonal clause without the required structural/semantic conditions is nonstandard.
decisions.current_norm_note: Recent Gramota/Russian Grammar explanations explicitly reject the obsolete blanket shortcut that gerunds cannot occur in impersonal sentences.

decisions.patch_policy: Keep spelling tied to lexical/syntactic construction, not pronunciation.

decisions.current_model: Derived adverbs are formed by truncating final -о of the motivating adverb and attaching по- plus -у; the same current model also includes помалу, понемножку, поровну.
decisions.patch_policy: Retain the positive word-formation explanation instead of the weak negative mnemonic 'not ПО-…-ОМУ'.
